message.content: {"label":"sufficient","reason":"The passages explicitly state that Airbnb earns revenue from service fees charged to hosts and guests for facilitating stays, that service fees are calculated as a percentage of the booking value excluding taxes, and that revenue is recognized upon check-in, with substantially all revenue from stays.","supported_requirements":[{"requirement":"Airbnb generates revenue from service fees charged to hosts and guests for facilitating stays (and experiences in some contexts).","passage_rank":1,"quote":"We recognize revenue upon check-in for a stay or experience from service fees charged to hosts and guests."},{"requirement":"Service fees are based on a percentage of the booking value, excluding taxes.","passage_rank":1,"quote":"We calculate Airbnb service fees based on a percentage of the booking value, exclusive of taxes."},{"requirement":"Revenue is recognized upon check-in (completion of the stay/experience).","passage_rank":3,"quote":"Revenue is recognized at a point in time when the performance obligation is satisfied upon check-in."},{"requirement":"Substantially all revenue comes from facilitating guest stays on the platform.","passage_rank":3,"quote":"We generate substantially all of our revenue from facilitating guest stays at accommodations offered by hosts on the Airbnb platform."}],"missing_requirements":[],"concerns":[]}
